svg.title: Measured source proportions and proposed principal-role engineering focus
svg.desc: The five code groups sum to 150112 code lines: graphics 47.3 percent, hosts 22.0, content/world 13.9, foundations 8.0 and tooling/automation 8.8. A separate effort proposal allocates release closeout 50 percent graphics, zero new model implementation, 30 evidence and 20 support. After release and classical prerequisites it proposes 40 graphics, 25 model, 25 evidence and 10 support. These effort targets are recommendations, not NVIDIA requirements or target code ratios.
